name: Thaumaturgy (Soul of the Serpent) — 1 Basic — Scaleskin

system.description:
The Thaumaturge's outer layer of skin becomes smooth and scaly like that of a river snake, granting greater flexibility and freedom of movement, including through water.

System: The character gains the ability to pass through any opening large enough to admit her head, and swims at normal walking speed. This can allow escape from restraints such as handcuffs.
